title: Kerberos: Remove the 3DES-only libnettle implementation
description:
There's not been a way to get the build system to define
HAVE_NETTLE without doing it manually since pre 2.0 (2014,
commit cc37b50334dc9aeb6f0c61301db40d95d4e11afd). Even
though the function calls were switched over to the libgcrypt
functions (which has nettle internally), I don't think there's
much call now for a 3DES-only implementation that requires
a special configuration with a slightly different format than
the standard Kerberos keytab file that hasn't been supported
for 12 years.

Ping #2089

AI-Assisted: no
